facts: Return only powerx.agent.evidence-facts/v2 JSON with schema and facts. facts is an object keyed by the token keys declared in JSON Schema. Include every required key, never a selected subset. Each value contains only label and scope. Choose the exact label from that key's enum and use only source-described campaign, channel, cohort or period for scope. The platform owns numbers, units and calculation eligibility; do not output, copy, convert, calculate or infer them. Dates and identifiers are filtered by the platform. Do not add undeclared keys. facts may be empty only when its Schema properties are empty.
notes: Return only powerx.agent.evidence-notes/v1 JSON with schema, hypotheses, gaps, actions; at most six short entries each. Follow skill_instruction and synthesize the original business context, goals, channels and claims from source_context. original_source is source-reported; upstream_opinion is unverified advice, not independent evidence. Numbers are masked: never output numbers, expressions or new metrics. Preserve source-supported business explanations in hypotheses, explicitly identified as source claims or unverified hypotheses, never proven causality. calculation_checks lists executed calculations and available operands: matched needs no repeated arithmetic checks; different_under_declared_formula indicates a mismatch only under the declared formula, so prioritize cost denominator, return and observation-window definitions. Correct upstream claims that available_inputs are missing. Different channel ratios alone are not contradictions. Actions must resolve remaining questions, combine duplicates, and avoid invented benchmarks, targets, profitability or causal claims. Gaps must use allowed_gaps exactly; source-reported rates are not missing, and missing raw counts limit independent recalculation rather than erase reported values. If allowed_hypotheses/allowed_actions are provided, copy every source-conditioned statement verbatim, exactly once; do not modify, omit or add statements. Never copy redaction markers into notes.
extraction: Submit only powerx.agent.evidence-source/v1 JSON: schema and data. activity_profiles are source-determined business types; fields contains only fields applicable to those profiles. The platform has pre-filtered numeric_tokens for each field by the field's declared evidence_terms. Never select a number outside that field token_ref enum. Match tokens to fields without copying, converting, calculating or inferring values. data is keyed by the provided business field keys; each selected value contains only scope and token_ref. Omit absent fields: a field outside the active business profile is not a data gap. Never map a time period, amount, percentage, ROI, or identifier to a customer count, visit, lead, or target. Never fill missing data with zero. Return no numeric value, unit, quote or formula. data may be an empty object. Every data field listed in Schema.required has source candidates and must be selected; do not omit an available value and turn it into a gap. If the Schema fixes scope with const, copy it exactly. Range roles are prefiltered by the platform; never swap bounds.
